What a strange thing! It happened to me once! I saw my grandmother...She passed away (may she sleep in peace) Her absence was more like a physical pain than just an internal pain, I slept in her house that night, I slept even though I was suffering from insomnia, what I remember is that I suddenly found myself in the hallway, I don't remember if I woke up or walked there at all, and she was at the end of the hallway, without thinking I ran to her and hugged her with all the strength God gave me... I didn't wake up until I heard my mother and sister waking me up in a panic. I was screaming in my sleep, crying and my nose was bleeding. It might have seemed like a dream... but it seemed very real. I wished it hadn't disappeared 🕊️💔

brother you need to move on, I know that you have been through something that has made you take your mind to that point, but, if you could get there, you can get out of there somehow, I have been there too, and I was able to get out, I know I may seem like a liar to you by saying that I got there, even if I didn't get there, I would be getting there for the simple fact of not motivating you to get out of that depression, I have always cared about people, if you are going through a hard time like This one, instead of immersing yourself, talk to someone, at least with someone, it could be me, but the important thing is that your physical and mental integrity are fine, please don't do anything bad to yourself, because the people who support you will be like You at this moment, you would no longer like to see people going through the same thing as you, I only come to tell you this, that you remain strong, that you overcome what torments you, having that determination and courage not to lose against a feeling and let yourself take care of him, I just want you to be well, cheer up friend. ❤

You have fought strong. You have faced battles no one else will ever see. We cannot force you to keep fighting, but we can help you rest. Do not feel obligated to live for someone, because your absence will hurt, that is no way to live. Live because you want to, because there's beauty in the world, and in yourself. If your bones truly ache for rest, there isn't much we as bystanders can do. I hope you are happier now, I hope that there is a light burning for you. I fear we have lost you, and my words are for a ghost, but I will mourn your soul as an internet stranger
